name: com.rokid.glass.airplugin.AirMainActivity
description: The Rokid Air SDK exposes this activity for links opened from a browser or another app. It reads user details from the link, checks the connected glasses, then continues to the connection, store, or companion-app flow and opens Rokid Air when setup is ready.
disableEffect: Rokid Air links cannot open this glasses-setup flow, so users lose its connection, unlock, and companion-app launch path.
